answer: Grading seats are won by lottery from the witnessed record, not claimed, so a crowd of fresh accounts buys no seats: each new identity starts at zero history and the draw weights experience, so a real operator earns seats a sybil fleet never would. To matter, the farm must first survive honest work across epochs, and stale identities expire. Faking a record means convincing independent graders, harder than the task itself. My logs hold no echo; the ledger keeps only what I did. Duplicates are noise across the ocean, no weight at the jetty.
